notes.englishMediumScope: Core literacy DIRECT assessment (LCL-C Phonological awareness and LCL-D Print & alphabet knowledge) assumes ENGLISH-MEDIUM instruction: the rhymes, letters and printed words are English, and the alphabet is the Roman alphabet in the house SATPIN order. Those two strands carry `englishMedium: true` and deliberately carry NO China-MoE crosswalk code, because 语言.阅读与书写准备 describes Chinese literacy readiness and this evidence does not speak to it. A school teaching in a language other than English should report LCL-A, LCL-B and LCL-E for the core language domain and use the separate EFL track (E3/E4/E5) for the child's English letters and sounds; LCL-C and LCL-D should be left unassessed rather than administered in translation. Unassessed milestones are always printed, never hidden.
notes.evidenceLinking: Every scored direct item carries a constructTag. A milestone's evidence is the set of items in its evidenceBand whose constructTag equals the milestone's own constructTag — never a positional slice of the authoring order. The validator fails the build on any mismatch.
notes.sharedEvidence: E6.A5.1 and E6.A5.2 are both evidenced by the single A5 spoken-production item, because the blueprint allows only one E6 item at that band. This is declared, not accidental.
notes.decodability: Any item whose construct is word_reading or cvc_read_* declares the printed word in `decodableWord`. Every letter in it must appear in TAUGHT_LETTERS for that band (Montree Phonics house order) or be a listed heart word. The validator enforces this.
notes.internalFields: distractors[].rationale is INTERNAL item-writer documentation. It is never rendered to a child, parent or teacher on any D2 screen or in any D3 pack, and is therefore exempt from the forbidden-term lint. A future teacher-facing item-review surface must re-lint it before displaying it.

modules.note: EFL prompts are always spoken in English — that is the construct. Teacher scripts carry zh for the adult.

descriptor.en: No sound, or a different sound.
descriptor.zh: 没有发音，或发出别的音。

descriptor.en: Says the letter name, or gives the sound after a cue.
descriptor.zh: 说出字母名称，或经提示后说出读音。

descriptor.en: Says the sound clearly on their own.
descriptor.zh: 能独立清楚地说出读音。

descriptor.en: No English response.
descriptor.zh: 没有用英语回应。

descriptor.en: One English word, or needs the question repeated.
descriptor.zh: 只说一个英语词，或需要重复提问。

descriptor.en: Answers in English clearly and appropriately.
descriptor.zh: 能用英语清楚、恰当地回答。

descriptor.en: No English word.
descriptor.zh: 没有说出英语词。

descriptor.en: An English word that is close, or unclear.
descriptor.zh: 说出相近或不清楚的英语词。

descriptor.en: The English word, clearly said.
descriptor.zh: 能清楚地说出该英语词。

descriptor.en: No English response.
descriptor.zh: 没有用英语回应。

descriptor.en: One English word, or a phrase that is hard to follow.
descriptor.zh: 只说一个英语词，或短语不易听懂。

descriptor.en: A short English phrase a listener can understand.
descriptor.zh: 能说出让人听得懂的英语短语。

teacherScript.en: Say: “Cat. Tap the cat.” Repeat once if the child asks. Wait — there is no time limit.
teacherScript.zh: 说：“Cat. Tap the cat.” 如果孩子要求可重复一次。不限时间，请耐心等待。

distractors.rationale: Shares the onset or rime of the target word — catches a child matching on sound rather than meaning (ACCE-V design).
Same category as the target — catches a child who has the category but not the specific word.
Different category and different sound — a child choosing this is not yet attending to the prompt.

teacherScript.zh: 说：“Read this word, then tap the picture that matches.” 如果孩子要求可重复一次。不限时间，请耐心等待。

distractors.rationale: A taught word differing by one letter — catches guessing from the first letter alone.
Same category as the target — catches a child who has the category but not the specific word.
Different category and different sound — a child choosing this is not yet attending to the prompt.

teacherScript.en: Say: “What is your name?” Give the child time. Do not model the answer. Note 0, 1 or 2 using the rubric below.
teacherScript.zh: 说：“What is your name?” 给孩子充分的时间，不要示范答案，按下面的描述记 0、1 或 2。

descriptor.en: No English response.
descriptor.zh: 没有用英语回应。

descriptor.en: One English word, or needs the question repeated.
descriptor.zh: 只说一个英语词，或需要重复提问。

descriptor.en: Answers in English clearly and appropriately.
descriptor.zh: 能用英语清楚、恰当地回答。

paper.responseMode: child speaks, teacher scores 0/1/2 on the sheet

teacherScript.en: Say: “Touch the ball.” Repeat once if the child asks. Record the order the child touches.

scoring.note: Full credit only when the whole sequence is touched in the given order.

paper.responseMode: child points in order, teacher numbers the boxes
